user.title: Casa Energy — New instance
user.description: Give this configuration a name (useful if in the future you want to track multiple meters, e.g. Home and Office).

energy_sensors.title: Energy consumption sensors
energy_sensors.description: Select one or more sensors with device_class 'energy' whose monthly history you want to track. For each one, the power sensor (Watts) of the same device will be identified automatically to calculate instant power: you don't need to select it again. These are the devices that count toward the total; any devices you want shown for display only, excluded from the total, are added directly from the card's editor.

ambiguous_power.title: Choose the power sensor
ambiguous_power.description: The device '{device_name}' (energy sensor: {energy_entity}) has more than one power sensor. Choose which one to use for the total calculation, and the name to display this load with.

unmatched_power.title: Power sensor not found
unmatched_power.description: No matching power sensor (Watts) was found for these devices: {devices}. They won't be counted in the total instant power until you add a power sensor to that device. Check the box to proceed anyway accepting this limitation, or go back and review your selection.

data.ignore_unmatched_power: Proceed anyway (these devices won't count toward the total)

tariff.title: Electricity tariff
tariff.description: If you change the price, fixed costs, extra fees, or tax rate, the new value applies from the 1st of the current month onward. Already-closed months stay fixed at the tariff they were calculated with, and won't change again even if you modify these values later.

data.reset_frozen_tariffs: Reset frozen tariffs (recalculate all past months with the tariff above)
data.manage_line_items: Manage advanced tariff line items (for bills with multiple fees, seasonal components, etc.)

manage_line_items.title: Advanced tariff line items ({count} present)
manage_line_items.description: These items are added on top of the four fields above: use them for distinct extra fees, seasonal components (e.g. active only in certain months), or amounts not subject to tax. Select any to remove, or check 'Add a new item' to create one.

edit_line_item.title: New tariff line item
edit_line_item.description: Free-form name (e.g. 'System charges', 'Seasonal contribution'). Type: 'Per kWh consumed' multiplies the value by the month's kWh; 'Fixed monthly amount' applies once regardless of consumption; 'Per kW of engaged power' multiplies the value by the power in kW entered below (for components calculated on the contract's power rather than consumption). The month range is optional: leave it empty to apply the item year-round, or set it for seasonal items (e.g. 1 to 10 for January-October).

data.name: Item name
data.value: Value (can be negative for a deduction)
data.engaged_power_kw: Engaged power in kW (only for the 'per kW of power' type)
data.apply_vat: Apply the tax rate configured above to this item
data.add_another: Add another item after this one
